narration.en: We thought there would always be another morning.
We kept postponing the moments that mattered, believing time would wait for us.
But life does not promise us another tomorrow.
Sometimes, we don't realize how precious an ordinary moment is until it becomes a memory.
Sit with them while they are still beside you.
Because not every tomorrow is promised.
